questions.question: What measures revenue generated per advertising dollar spent?
What funnel stage represents awareness, interest, desire, and action?
What targeting method uses cookies to track users?
What metric measures customer acquisition efficiency?
questions.explanation: CAC calculates cost to acquire customers.

questions.question: What value represents total revenue from a customer relationship?
What optimization technique improves conversion rates?
What attribution model gives equal credit to all touchpoints?
What marketing creates collaborative relationships with influencers?
What technique nurtures leads through targeted content?
What bidding strategy automatically optimizes for conversions?
What attribution model credits only the last touchpoint before conversion?
questions.explanation: Last-click assigns all credit to the final interaction.

questions.question: What attribution model credits only the first touchpoint?
questions.explanation: First-click values the initial discovery interaction.

questions.question: Of 200 shoppers who added to cart, 50 completed purchase. What is the cart-to-purchase conversion rate?
What minimum confidence level is standard for valid A/B test results?
What metric measures the average revenue generated per order?
questions.explanation: AOV divides revenue by order count.

questions.question: A store spends 50,000 pesos on Meta ads and earns 250,000 pesos in tracked revenue. What is its ROAS?
questions.explanation: ROAS = revenue / ad spend = 250,000 / 50,000 = 5, i.e., five pesos earned per peso spent.

questions.question: Of 8,000 site sessions, 240 ended in a purchase. What is the conversion rate?
Of 1,500 carts created, 1,050 were abandoned before checkout. What is the cart abandonment rate?
An affiliate partner is paid 200 pesos only when a referred visitor actually completes a purchase. Which pricing model is this?
questions.explanation: CPA (cost per action/acquisition) pays only on a completed conversion, unlike CPC or CPM.
